status: Selected for the unchanged calibrated tower; best demonstrated live balance at the conclusion of these trials.
selection_reason: The 600-feature setting passed the fresh tower movement check and improved medium late and full ATE versus 500 features at modest extra CPU. Faster raw-image candidates have mixed error and no live validation.
limitations: Not the lowest CPU of all public candidates.
No independent live ground truth or matched live OpenVINS CPU comparison.
Medium late error still exceeds the narrow-pyramid 600-feature reference.
General equality to OpenVINS CPU with preserved quality remains unproven.
No more experiments planned after the current worker trial at the request to conclude.
